remarks: Beautifully maintained end-unit that truly lives like a single-family home, complete with a stunning rooftop patio. Unit #23 welcomes you with a charming portico entry, grassy yard and garden beds. Inside, the home features include hardwood floors throughout, a bright open layout, and a balcony off the dining area-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The second floor offers two bedrooms, a full bath, and convenient laundry, while the entire third floor is dedicated to a serene primary suite with an en-suite bath. Above it all, the rooftop Trex patio is the standout-offering city views and exceptional space to relax or entertain. Only one like it in the complex!  Meticulously cared for and thoughtfully upgraded, including California Closets, enhanced security, epoxy garage floor, high-end lighting, and custom window treatments. Enjoy effortless living in a prime location-walk to Bedford Street's restaurants, coffee shops, and library, with easy access to parks, Ridgeway Shopping Center, nearby suburban neighborhoods, and public transportation.
